fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-06-19 states that the complainant paid Rs. 1,85,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed, on 2025-06-18 at approximately 10:10. Saravanan Sundaram submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000258. The account reference SYN-ACC-100053 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. Madhan Murugan (9000000216) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Venkat Palanisamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000134, in connection with the events. Prakash Muthu (9000000312), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, associate, main street, witness, bank account, suspect, screenshot
